scope: Descriptive corporate-structure, contract and investment dataset for Gautam Adani's Adani Group (Ahmedabad, founded as Adani Exports in 1988). Deepens the 'adani' entry in research/raw/conglomerates.json. NO ALLEGATIONS, investigations, indictments or wrongdoing claims are included, by design. Where a fact is materially disputed the dispute is stated neutrally in 'notes'.

method.primaryBackbone: The entity map is built from the Form AOC-1 subsidiary/associate schedules in the FY2025-26 integrated annual reports of Adani Enterprises, Adani Ports & SEZ, Adani Power, Adani Energy Solutions and Ambuja Cements, downloaded from the NSE archive. These are statutory filings under section 129(3) of the Companies Act 2013 and are treated as primary records.
method.tickersAndIsins: Every NSE symbol, ISIN and listing date is taken from the NSE master security list (EQUITY_L.csv), not from an aggregator.
method.marketCaps: Market capitalisation and promoter-holding percentages are read from Screener.in company pages on 2026-08-11 (intraday) and are stamped, not current.
method.registeredVsOperational: Registered office governs 'state'/'stateCode' where it was verified. Where only the operational site is known, that is stated explicitly in 'notes' and the registered office is flagged as unverified. This distinction is the single most common error in state-wise corporate maps.
method.nullPolicy: No figure, ticker, CIN, ISIN, stake, date or URL in this file is estimated, inferred or recalled. Anything not verified against a fetched source is null with a corresponding 'gaps' entry. Where two sources conflicted, the field is null and the conflict is recorded.
method.accessConstraint: All adani.com and Adani operating-company domains, zaubacorp.com and business-standard.com returned HTTP 403 to automated fetching throughout this work, so the group's own press releases could not be read directly. NSE-archived filings were used instead wherever possible.

disambiguation: This file covers GAUTAM ADANI's Adani Group, headquartered at Adani Corporate House, Shantigram, Ahmedabad. It is not related to Gujarat Ambuja Exports Ltd (NSE: GAEL), a separate Ahmedabad company with a similar name that appears adjacent in exchange listings.
Ambuja Cements Ltd (Adani group, since 2022) must not be confused with Gujarat Ambuja Exports Ltd (unrelated) or with Holcim, its former owner.

PRS Tolls Ltd (an Adani Road Transport SPV) is not PS Toll Road Pvt Ltd, a separate Pune-Satara highway concessionaire belonging to another group, which does not appear in the Adani Enterprises consolidation.

VINOD S. ADANI, EXACTLY AS PUBLICLY DISCLOSED: in a stock-exchange filing dated 16 March 2023 the Adani Group stated that 'Mr. Gautam Adani and Mr. Rajesh Adani are individual promoters of various listed entities within the Adani group and Mr. Vinod Adani is an immediate relative of the individual promoters', and that this makes him part of the PROMOTER GROUP (not an individual promoter) of various listed entities, a relationship the group said had been disclosed to Indian regulatory authorities. Nothing beyond that disclosure is asserted here: no executive role, no shareholding and no other relationship.

baseRateNotes: COMPARISON FAMILY DECLARED BEFORE COUNTING. The reference class used throughout is India's large diversified infrastructure-and-industrial conglomerates: Reliance, Tata, Aditya Birla, JSW, Vedanta, Bajaj, Mahindra, L&T, Hinduja, GMR and Adani — the same ten groups already carried in research/raw/conglomerates.json plus GMR where airports are the subject. Denominators below are published with the numerators.

AIRPORTS — HOLDING A CONCESSION IS NOT DISTINCTIVE; THE 2019 SWEEP IS. The Airports Authority of India manages about 137 airports; Adani operates 8, i.e. roughly 6% of AAI airports but a stated 23% of India's passenger traffic. Other groups hold comparable concessions: GMR at Delhi (concession awarded May 2006, now GMR 74% / AAI 26%) and Hyderabad, Zurich Airport International at Noida/Jewar (won November 2019, 40-year DBFOT, concession signed 7 October 2020), and formerly GVK, Fraport and Malaysia Airports. So 'a conglomerate holds an Indian airport concession' has a high base rate and proves nothing. What IS unusual is the 2018-19 outcome: a single bidder won all six airports in one round. The mechanism is documented and mundane — a single-variable price auction on the highest monthly per-passenger fee, 10 companies, 32 technical bids, 3 to 7 bids per airport — and Adani's bids (Rs 115-177/passenger) were 2 to 4 times the nearest published rivals (GMR Rs 18-85, AMP Capital Rs 139). The innocent reading is straightforward: on a one-variable auction, the highest number wins six times if it is the highest number six times. FALSIFIER for any adverse reading: evidence that the bid parameter, eligibility criteria or evaluation were changed after bids were known would matter; the published record shows a uniform parameter applied to all six.

MUMBAI IS NOT A GOVERNMENT AWARD. Two of the group's eight airports (Mumbai, and Navi Mumbai held through it) came from acquiring GVK's interest in the concession holder, not from winning a tender. Any count of 'airports the government gave Adani' that reaches 8 is wrong by two.

TRANSMISSION — THE COMPANY PUBLISHES ITS OWN DENOMINATOR. Adani Energy Solutions states a 29% share of TBCB transmission projects. That is a large minority and 71% of the market sits elsewhere. In the 10-40% band this is 'moderate' on the evidence-tiering scale: worth arguing about, with the denominator published, and nowhere near a monopoly claim.

THERMAL POWER. Adani Power is India's largest PRIVATE thermal producer at a stated 7.3% of national coal-based capacity — the state sector still holds the overwhelming majority. Its growth since 2022 came predominantly from buying distressed assets out of insolvency (Mahan 2022, Lanco Amarkantak 2024, Coastal Energen 2024, Vidarbha Industries 2025), a route open to and used by many bidders.

SOLAR AUCTIONS DISTRIBUTE. SECI's 1,000 MW ISTS Tranche XVIII was split three ways between ReNew, ACME and an Adani entity. A single auction win is the modal outcome for a large Indian renewables developer, not a discriminating fact.

PM CARES — NON-DISCRIMINATING (WELL ABOVE THE 80% THRESHOLD). Contributing to PM CARES in 2020 was close to universal among large Indian business groups: Tata Sons/Trusts Rs 1,500 cr, Reliance Rs 500 cr, Aditya Birla Rs 400 cr, Adani Foundation Rs 100 cr, JSW Rs 100 cr, Kotak Rs 25 cr plus Rs 25 cr personally, TVS Rs 25 cr, with Azim Premji Foundation at about Rs 1,000 cr of COVID relief. On the independent Hurun India Philanthropy List 2020 Gautam Adani ranked NINTH at Rs 88 crore, behind Premji, Nadar, Ambani, Birla, Agarwal, Piramal, Nilekani and the Hindujas. By the evidence-tiering table this edge is non-discriminating and should be rendered as context, not as a finding. Note also the direction: Adani's contribution was one fifteenth of Tata's and one fifth of Reliance's.

PM CARES — A STRUCTURAL CAVEAT THAT APPLIES TO EVERY DONOR. The fund publishes no donor list; its official site carries only audited receipt-and-payment accounts. Every donor figure in circulation, including Adani's, originates from the donor's own announcement. Presence on a donor list is therefore unauditable and ABSENCE FROM ONE IS NOT EVIDENCE OF NON-DONATION. Any analysis that treats these lists as complete is mis-specified.

CSR IS A STATUTORY LEVY, NOT PHILANTHROPY — SO IT CARRIES ZERO SIGNALLING VALUE. Section 135 of the Companies Act 2013 requires any company with net worth of Rs 500 crore or turnover of Rs 1,000 crore or net profit of Rs 5 crore to spend at least 2% of the average net profit of the preceding three years, with unspent amounts transferred to an Unspent CSR Account and a penalty of twice the unspent amount or Rs 1 crore, whichever is less. Adani Enterprises spent Rs 60.18 crore in FY2025-26 against a legal minimum of Rs 59.77 crore — 100.7% of the obligation, i.e. about 99.3% of the spend was legally compelled. Ambuja spent Rs 62.02 crore against Rs 60.98 crore (101.7%). The one genuine outlier runs the OTHER way: Adani Ports spent Rs 154.19 crore against a Rs 24.19 crore obligation, 6.4 times the statutory minimum, with Rs 130 crore of excess available for set-off. Reading a large CSR number as influence-buying gets the base rate exactly backwards for the first two companies and requires a separate explanation for the third.

SOVEREIGN-WEALTH INVESTMENT IN INDIAN CONGLOMERATES IS ROUTINE. In a seven-week window in 2020, Jio Platforms (Reliance) raised Rs 97,885.65 crore from Facebook, Silver Lake, Vista, General Atlantic, KKR, Mubadala and ADIA, with ADIA alone putting Rs 5,683.50 crore in for 1.16%. Gulf and Asian sovereign funds hold positions across the largest Indian groups. QIA in Adani Electricity Mumbai and IHC in the Adani listed companies are instances of a common pattern, not a distinguishing one.

ELECTORAL BONDS — A DOCUMENTED VOID, RENDERED AS LOUDLY AS A PRESENCE. In the ECI/SBI disclosure published in March 2024 covering 22,217 bonds purchased between 1 April 2019 and 15 February 2024, and the 213 donors who bought more than Rs 10 crore each, NO ADANI GROUP ENTITY APPEARS. Reliance and Tata are likewise absent as named purchasers. The top purchasers were Future Gaming and Hotel Services (Rs 1,368 cr), Megha Engineering (Rs 966 cr), Qwik Supply Chain (Rs 410 cr), Vedanta (about Rs 398-400 cr), Bharti (Rs 247 cr), Essel Mining (Rs 224 cr) and DLF (Rs 170 cr). CORRECT FRAMING: this covers the electoral bond instrument only, in those entities' own names; it is silent about other lawful funding routes and about entities not named. It is a factual disclosure, not an allegation in either direction, and the absence is a finding in its own right.

THE SPV LATTICE IS A CONSTRUCTION ARTEFACT, NOT A FINDING. This file records 220 entities, of which about half are single-purpose project companies. That density is what Indian infrastructure law and lender ring-fencing produce: TBCB transmission projects are awarded to a bid-specific SPV that is transferred to the winner, road and port concessions require project-specific concessionaires, and offshore trading arms sit in free zones for ordinary tax and treasury reasons. Running the same Form AOC-1 extraction on Reliance, Tata, L&T, GMR or Vedanta would produce a comparably large lattice. SYMMETRY CHECK OWED: before any structural claim is drawn from the count, the identical extraction must be run on at least two control groups. Until then, 'hundreds of subsidiaries' is a property of the method, not of the subject.

MULTIPLE-COMPARISONS DISCIPLINE. This dataset spans 220 entities, 12 government-contract rows, 18 foreign-investor rows and 7 philanthropic rows. Any scan for coincidences across these — shared states, shared dates, shared counterparties — has a comparison family in the tens of thousands of pairs. No motif from such a scan should ship as a finding without a degree-preserving null model and a corrected significance level, per the pattern-discipline checklist.

CIN AND INCORPORATION DATE ARE NULL FOR MOST NON-LISTED ENTITIES. Registry mirrors (zaubacorp) returned HTTP 403 and the MCA portal was not reachable, so 207 of the 220 entities carry no CIN. Where two mirrors disagreed the field was set to null rather than picked: this affects the incorporation dates of Ambuja Cements (October vs December 1981), NDTV (September vs December 1988), Adani Total Gas (August vs December 2005, resolved to August on two fetched sources) and Adani Airport Holdings (2 August vs 2 December 2019).

Several may in fact be registered at the group's Ahmedabad address. Do not use SPV state codes for a registered-HQ map without re-verification.

THE DHARAVI REDEVELOPMENT SPV (reported as Navbharat Mega Developers Pvt Ltd, with a reported 80:20 Adani-Maharashtra split) could not be verified from any fetched source and is therefore absent from the entity map entirely.

GROUP MARKET CAPITALISATION IS DELIBERATELY NOT TOTALLED HERE, because two of the eleven listed entities (ACC and Orient Cement) are subsidiaries of a third (Ambuja) and summing them double-counts. The per-entity stamped figures should be used instead.
